text:
Asking rents in Dusseldorf stand at a median of 14.45 €/m² (2026-06), up 4.1% on the year and +29.6% over five years. That ranks Dusseldorf #8 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 56% above the 2022 average contract rent of 9.24 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 867 € a month in cold rent, 16.0% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 26 days and 29% are gone within a week; with 1.6% market-active vacancy and +1.9% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 15.32 €/m² (+6.0%), with an 80% range of 14.91 to 15.55 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
